findings.claim: The required end-to-end payout flow fails because the payout page shows 0 zł after the job instead of the expected 135 zł.
findings.evidence: The supplied E2E run reports an assertion failure on `/135 zł/`; the page text showed “Do wypłaty 0 zł” and no paid amount.
findings.fix: Trace why this flow leaves the payout unpaid, fix the underlying payout path, and rerun the payout E2E scenario to confirm the 135 zł transfer and displayed total.

findings.claim: The added tests do not cover required risk-high payout cases, including transfer failures and retries, lease takeover, refund races, webhook ordering and replay, or two-account denied access.
findings.evidence: The transfer DB test covers a pending account, one successful concurrent transfer, a rerun, and one dashboard refund; the onboarding test checks separate accounts and scoped summaries but does not test denied reads or writes. No added payout webhook test is present among the listed files.
findings.fix: Add the spec-required DB tests for failure/retry and takeover behavior, refund timing, `account.updated` ordering and replay, `transfer.*` adoption, and two-account denied read/write with owner data unchanged.
